name: not-ai
description: Rewrite prose so it reads like a person wrote it. Uses research-informed structural editing, genre profiles, and a bundled deterministic pre-output gate. The gate separates hard typography failures from advisory editorial findings and never claims an authorship or detector verdict.

interface.shortDescription: Prose that reads like a person wrote it. Research-backed structural rewriting.
interface.longDescription: A research-informed prose editing skill. It targets clause type distribution, sentence rhythm, nominalization density, and epistemic stance instead of word swapping. It includes a bundled Python pre-output gate that reports deterministic mechanics and advisory editorial findings by genre. It never fabricates facts or claims an authorship or detector verdict.
capabilities: Rewrite AI-sounding prose by restructuring clauses, not swapping words
Measure structural features with deterministic Python scripts before rewriting
Adapt to 8 genres: LinkedIn, academic, technical, email, README, social, fiction, personal essay
Write from scratch that avoids generated-text patterns from the start
Diagnose which structural patterns make a passage read as AI
defaultPrompt: Rewrite this so it does not sound like AI
